metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the porch, the letter to Anne, and the coffer opened on what is spoken for.

yesterday: The wash stands. Fourpence the week, already paid out of the Michaelmas money.
The Christmas money is so much for the house, so much for the shop, and so much she may spend. The sheet waits for the carrier of the fourth.
You asked whether the string-and-spool engine still works, or has been forbidden.

The coffer was opened, both locks. Spoken for: Mistress Ansell's Christmas quarter at twenty shillings, sixty shillings home, the hose, the river, the brief, and two pounds lent to Quiney on the seventh of August. A house by the chapel stays an address. The foot of the leaf has no total.
Tomorrow the house is dark. You mean to walk west. Twelve pence at the gate.
